name: Room Booking Invoice
script:
booking = frappe.get_doc("Room Booking", frappe.form_dict.room_booking)

if not booking.customer:
    frappe.throw("Укажите Customer в бронировании")

if not booking.hotel_profile:
    frappe.throw("Укажите Hotel Profile в бронировании")

hotel_profile = frappe.get_doc("Hotel Profile", booking.hotel_profile)

if not hotel_profile.default_service:
    frappe.throw("В Hotel Profile не указан Default Service")

if booking.sales_invoice and frappe.db.exists("Sales Invoice", booking.sales_invoice):
    old_si_name = booking.sales_invoice

    frappe.db.set_value("Room Booking", booking.name, "sales_invoice", None)

    old_si = frappe.get_doc("Sales Invoice", old_si_name)
    if old_si.docstatus == 1:
        old_si.cancel()
    elif old_si.docstatus == 0:
        old_si.delete()

si = frappe.new_doc("Sales Invoice")
si.customer = booking.customer
si.company = booking.company

# Accommodation line (проживание)
si.append("items", {
    "item_code": hotel_profile.default_service,
    "qty": 1,
    "rate": booking.amount,
    "warehouse": hotel_profile.warehouse
})

# Additional items/services (мини-бар, услуги и т.п.)
for row in booking.items_and_service:
    si.append("items", {
        "item_code": row.item,
        "qty": row.qty,
        "rate": row.rate,
        "warehouse": hotel_profile.warehouse
    })

si.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.db.set_value("Room Booking", booking.name, "sales_invoice", si.name)

frappe.response["message"] = si.name
